findings.description: Decision 66 claims a task id with no alphanumeric character at all slugs to the empty string via sessionSlug, but the regex collapses any such run to a single '-', not ''.
findings.suggestion: a task id that is itself the empty string slugs to the empty string too (a run of non-alphanumeric characters instead collapses to a single `-`, which still passes the charset) — `sessionFragment` now refuses that case rather than letting `compiledDir` become the shared `<store>/sessions/compiled`.

findings.description: The same two rationales (closed-allowlist-vs-'..'-check, and readers-skip-so-the-row-still-renders-sanitized) are restated near-verbatim across the decision doc, the CLI doc, and two source docstrings — each is a legitimate WHY in isolation but the shared narrative will need to be kept in sync across four+ places on any future change to this mechanism.

SESSION_ID_PATTERN's natural owner is paths.utils.ts (which session-dossier.service.ts already imports from), not the narrower session-activity.constants.ts — housing it there makes the foundational paths.utils.ts reach into a module meant for stall/activity-classification constants, a cohesion/placement mismatch with no behavioral consequence.

row.transcript_path is read and passed to latestContextTokens with no shape check; since decisions 60-62 the dashboard reads every registered project's store, so a hostile row could set transcript_path to an arbitrary path — the same attacker-controlled-column-into-filesystem-path class decision 66 just closed for id, left open here and out of this PR's declared scope.
